<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word from one insight cited in the same sentence.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Our current claims-handling software enforces a single, one-size-fits-all method for routing claims. This does not accommodate the distinct needs of different teams within our customer accounts. Motor teams require efficient, high-volume processing with automatic assignment based on postcode and workload, while commercial and specialty teams need manual control to handle complex cases effectively. The inflexible system slows down efficient work and misallocates complex claims, hurting resolution quality and team productivity.

## Who is affected
- **Motor teams** who need automatic claim routing by postcode and workload for efficiency and scaling [i:0be083b63305da63][i:9bcfbf187a659dd5][i:63e7d0c8fea46281].
- **Commercial and specialty claims teams** who require manual claim routing to properly manage complex files [i:335a45d6e8f1c018][i:49e903683f464d34][i:a134bd501c3f8a83].
- **Accounts with multiple claim types**, such as Wexmoor Motor, Saltmarsh Specialty, Marrowgate Commercial, Tidewell Marine & Cargo, Ravensgill Insurance, and Callowfield Auto Assurance, where a single routing method fails to serve all teams [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:9179fd051ca6a5f8][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].

## Evidence
- The issue has been raised by **6 accounts** in a total of **13 mentions** across **2 routes**: support and onboarding [i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:ec07f5c294ac850c].
- **9 mentions** came through the support route and **4 mentions** through the onboarding route [i:0be083b63305da63][i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].
- The affected accounts represent a significant portion of our revenue, with a combined **ARR total of £6,430,000** [i:35df28f51fb00a24][i:bd7f9775285147df][i:c8869934e9e77aad].
- **Wexmoor Motor** (ARR: £1,950,000) has stated, "we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones" and also asked, "can we turn off auto‑routing for our commercial claims? They’re too complex" [i:0be083b63305da63][i:a134bd501c3f8a83].
- **Saltmarsh Specialty** (ARR: £740,000) reported, "Our motor team wants claims routed automatically based on postcode and workload, but our specialty handlers need manual control for complex cases — it’s a team‑level thing" [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6].
- **Marrowgate Commercial** (ARR: £1,600,000) noted, "Our commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful — we need manual claim routing to manage complex files properly" [i:49e903683f464d34].
- **Tidewell Marine & Cargo** (ARR: £420,000) said, "Our motor team handles high-volume cases and wants automatic assignment based on postcode and workload... manual claim routing slows them down too much" but also prefers "manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us" for other teams [i:63e7d0c8fea46281][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12].
- **Ravensgill Insurance** (ARR: £470,000) stated, "Our motor team wants more automatic claim allocation based on postcode and workload, but commercial prefers manual control for complex cases" [i:c8869934e9e77aad].
- **Callowfield Auto Assurance** (ARR: £1,250,000) explained, "Our motor teams are pushing for automated claim routing by postcode and workload, but our commercial teams need manual claim routing for complex cases" [i:ec07f5c294ac850c].

## Why now
- Customer feedback has been concentrated recently, with multiple mentions occurring in **October 2026** [i:0be083b63305da63][i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:335a45d6e8f1c018].
- The upcoming renewal cycle adds urgency, as **Marrowgate Commercial**, with an ARR of £1,600,000, has a renewal date of **2026-12-12** [i:335a45d6e8f1c018][i:49e903683f464d34].
- Only **1 renewal** has occurred in the last 90 days, indicating a critical period for addressing customer concerns to secure renewals for the other five accounts [i:9179fd051ca6a5f8][i:bd7f9775285147df][i:c8869934e9e77aad].
- The consistent request across accounts for "per-team configuration" highlights a systemic gap that is actively hindering operational efficiency for our key customers [i:2b8201db7ce2cec6][i:3ccee6c1b85c3e12][i:c8869934e9e77aad].
",
  "citations": ["0be083b63305da63", "9bcfbf187a659dd5", "63e7d0c8fea46281", "335a45d6e8f1c018", "49e903683f464d34", "a134bd501c3f8a83", "2b8201db7ce2cec6", "9179fd051ca6a5f8", "ec07f5c294ac850c", "3ccee6c1b85c3e12", "35df28f51fb00a24", "bd7f9775285147df", "c8869934e9e77aad"]
}
